value.message: How can I use simulations to improve IAR?

Simulations allow you to evaluate the potential for intent-based deflection before you officially deploy Issue Auto Resolution. You can run simulations against historical data and review how IAR performs in terms of intent prediction and topic mapping. This capability is currently only available for Incidents as part of the ITSM Virtual Agent Conversations application.

Before running a simulation, make sure that you have trained the Machine Learning model under the Incident IAR configuration. For best results, tune the model in NLU Workbench to increase accuracy. Once the model is trained, you can create multiple simulations based on different conditions. Ensure that there are fewer than 50,000 records for each simulation. Within each simulation, you can complete multiple runs to compare results over time.
